Harper comes along and says, well, you shouldn't torture people just for fun. You could say it's irrational for me to do it, but that is a very toothless type of irrationality. So if it's irrational for me to act in ways that always achieve my goals and desires.
I guess I just don't care about being rational. You know, what I would favor, you know, if you were just going to say rationality is not connected to acting in a way that promotes my goals and desires, I don't care to be rational. I'm anti-rational then. I would just care about smash-ionality. And smash-ionality is whatever reasoning processes or system of justification or norms or way of making decisions results in me acting in a way that does promote my goals and interests.
So, you know, one of my more fundamental issues with these alleged stance independent moral facts is why should anyone care about them? I don't understand why I should care about being moral. Well, so, I mean, so my answer is.
